public_signatures.name: spear
public_signatures.text:
A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.

Typically this _tier-2_ melee weapon deals _2-20 damage_ and requires _12 strength_ to use properly.

This is a rather slow weapon.
This weapon has extra reach.

The Duelist can use the tip of a spear to _spike_ an enemy that is in range but not adjacent. This typically deals _11-29 damage_, knocks the enemy back, and is guaranteed to hit.
